assumptions.background: unchanged spherical iron core and ice shell
assumptions.parcels: point-source representation of fixed total additional energy
assumptions.physics: Newtonian inverse-square sum; E/c^2 as a weak-field source proxy

classification: CONVENTIONAL NUMERICAL MULTIPOLE SCOUT — NO NEW GRAVITY
limits: Parcels idealize spatially localized additional energy as Newtonian point sources; not real zero-size material inclusions.
The spherical iron-core/ice-shell background is held fixed, so its common exterior Newtonian field cancels in field differences.
No mechanical equilibrium, supporting apparatus, binding stress, pressure contribution, GR stress-energy tensor, or Einstein equations are solved.
Energy rearrangement pathways and energy transport are not modeled; only matched endpoint configurations are compared.
The one-hundred-million-joule redistributed energy is illustrative, not a measured asteroid perturbation.
The computed quadrupole tensor is source-defined, traceless, and Cartesian; it does not capture all higher multipoles.
A vanishing quadrupole does not imply a spherically symmetric full source; cubic source parcels have higher multipoles.
The absolute gravitational corrections are extraordinarily small; no instrumental feasibility or observation is claimed.
No new information-field coupling, novel gravitational law, or gravitational information instructions are inferred.
scientific_verdict: Asymmetric conventional sources can have different external Newtonian fields at matched total energy and dipole. No information-field coupling is derived or detected.
